about_the_game:
Welcome to Market Simulator — a deeply immersive, first-person retail management experience where your journey from a modest shop owner to a thriving market tycoon begins.

Whether you’re a strategic thinker, an interior design enthusiast, or just love the satisfying rhythm of retail, Market Simulator puts you in complete control of every detail behind running your very own supermarket.

🏪 Build the Store of Your Dreams

Start with a blank space and transform it into a fully operational, customer-friendly marketplace. Design your layout with efficiency and style in mind — from shelving units and fridges to product displays and checkout counters. Optimize for flow, aesthetics, and profit.

📦 Stock Smart, Sell Smarter

Use your in-game computer to browse a dynamic market system and order stock at the best prices. Receive deliveries, unpack goods, sort them in your storage area, and place them thoughtfully throughout your store. Be strategic — timing and selection can make or break your margins.

💳 Master the Checkout Counter

Man the register yourself: scan items, handle payments, and make sure customers leave with a smile. Accept both cash and credit, bag groceries with care, and keep the lines moving smoothly for peak efficiency.

📈 Play the Market

Track product trends, buy low, and sell high. Adjust your prices to attract more customers or maximize profit. Monitor customer satisfaction and demand — the better your service and pricing, the stronger your reputation becomes.

🧱 Expand, Upgrade, Dominate

Reinvest your hard-earned profits to expand your floor space, renovate your store, and upgrade equipment. Adapt to the evolving needs of your growing customer base and stay ahead in a competitive retail world.

In Market Simulator, every decision matters.
Will you build a local shopping haven or a retail empire? The market is waiting.

  • Processor: Intel Core i3

  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1060 3GB, AMD RX 470 4GB, Intel UHD graphics 630
